title: Why cant we appeal hackers for ban evading

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body: The reason why your appeal was denied is because you lied in your appeal. If you really wanted to be unbanned, you would take the time to write a proper appeal, and be 100% honest. You won't be appealed anytime soon unless you admit to ban evading, and show the right attitude in your appeal. In your previous appeal, you kept insisting that we tell you which account you were ban evading on, which implied that you are clearly not ready to be appealed yet. You may try to appeal in the future, but we will instantly deny your appeal again if you are caught lying.
